instruction: Go to slide 1 and change the title text color to red.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to slide 1 and changing the title text color to red (RGB: 255, 0, 0). The evaluator extracts the title text color from slide 1 and compares it against the expected red color with a tolerance of 5 for each RGB component.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Slide index mismatch - instruction says 'slide 1' (first slide, human-readable) but evaluator uses slide_index=1 (second slide, 0-based). Should use slide_index=0 to check the first slide.

LOGIC ISSUE: Getter only checks the first text run's color in the title. If title has multiple runs with different colors, only the first is verified. Instruction 'change the title text color to red' could mean all title text should be red.
EDGE CASE: Getter only handles RGB color type (type==1). If user sets red color using theme/scheme color, getter returns None and metric fails (false negative).
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change slide_index from 1 to 0 in evaluator config to check the first slide (slide 1 in human-readable terms).
Modify getter to check ALL text runs in the title, not just the first one. Either verify all runs are red, or calculate average/dominant color.
Enhance getter to handle different color types (RGB, theme, scheme). Convert theme/scheme colors to RGB for comparison, or check color type more flexibly.
